description: This file defines a React component 'SessionDetailsModal' that renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information about a session, including user info, timestamps, and session metadata. It uses hooks for state management, effects for data fetching, and utility functions for formatting. The component is styled for responsiveness and accessibility.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a localized string or an em-dash if invalid or missing.

methods.name: computeDuration
methods.description: Calculates a human-readable duration string from start and end timestamps.

methods.name: resolveUserName
methods.description: Resolves a user-friendly name from various user reference formats, searching in context data if necessary.

methods.name: pickFrom
methods.description: Safely retrieves the first defined value from an object based on a list of keys, supporting nested keys.
